This list is displayed in CLA J26 next to the door. There is no phone inside the lab: call from a mobile phone or from the phone at the safety station on the corridor (when you leave CLA J26, turn right; the phone is before the elevators, about 10 m from the door).

## Telephone numbers for emergencies

| Emergency                                             | Responsible unit   | Telephone number                                 |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Incidents, accidents, fire, first aid                 | ETH Emergency Desk | 888 (ETH landline) or +41 44 342 11 88 (mobile)  |
| Technical problems                                    | ETH Emergency Desk | 888 (ETH landline) or +41 44 342 11 88 (mobile)  |
| Fire                                                  | Fire brigade       | 0-118 (ETH landline) or 118 (mobile)             |
| Medical problems                                      | Ambulance          | 0-144 (ETH landline) or 144 (mobile)             |
| Poisoning, intoxication, effects of chemical exposure | ETH Emergency Desk | 888 (ETH landline) or +41 44 342 11 88 (mobile)  |
